title: Benchmark Production-Call-Path Fidelity
canonicalBaseCommitDescription: PR #172 / RESOLVER-V3-049 merge commit, origin/chore/clean-arch-structure tip at task start

oldBoundary.description: ResolverV3VariantAAdapter.runVariantACase() (pre-fix) sent normalizeText(benchmarkCase.rawInput) directly to the resolver as the FoodSearchQuery.normalized field, never invoking DeterministicFoodParser first.

correctedBoundary.description: ResolverV3VariantAAdapter.runVariantACase() now calls DeterministicFoodParser.parse(benchmarkCase.rawInput) first, then sends normalizeText(parsed.name) to the resolver -- reproducing LogFoodFromRawInputUseCase.resolveCanonicalFood()'s exact production call order.

queryConstruction.raw: benchmarkCase.rawInput (unchanged -- production's FoodSearchQuery.raw is also the original, unparsed rawInput)
queryConstruction.inputType: detectInputType(benchmarkCase.rawInput) (unchanged -- production already derives inputType from the original raw input, not the parsed name)

correctedBoundary.sharedFixPoint: ResolverV3VariantAAdapter.runVariantACase() is the single call site used by Variant A, Variant C's deterministic fast path (ResolverV3VariantCAdapter.buildFastPathMealResult), RepresentativeHybridV1ThreeArmRunner (fixture execution), RepresentativeHybridV1LiveRunner (live execution preparation), and LearningBenchmarkV2's resolution scenario evaluator -- fixing it once corrects all of them.

oldOutcome.defectMechanism: "ein apfel" is a substring of the normalized BLS record name "apfelkuechlein apfelringe im milchbackteig gebraten" ("...kuechl[ein] [apfel]ringe..."), spuriously matched via BlsLookupEngine's includes-match stage.

correctedOutcome.note: Matches the honest ambiguity result production already gives for this input -- not the historical false acceptance.

residualRiskCases.finding: Corrected boundary parses to "snack", which substring/token-matches the single real BLS record "Kichererbsensnack gebacken" (X5A1030) and is accepted -- violating this case's own ground truth (expectedBehavior: abstention_expected, criticalFailureConditions naming exactly this scenario). This is a pre-existing production BLS fast-path substring-collision defect, NOT introduced by RESOLVER-V3-050 -- production already parses "Ein Snack" to "snack" today; the OLD, unfaithful benchmark boundary simply never exercised this call path (it sent "ein snack" verbatim, which does not collide). Not fixed by this task (out of scope: no resolver/BLS/parser behavior change). See report body Residual Risks.

historicalProtocolStatus.v3039: immutable, byte-unchanged (seven controlled representative live evidence files + closeout report + manifest) -- collected under the OLD, unfaithful benchmark boundary; SHA-256 verified unchanged before and after this task
historicalProtocolStatus.disclosure: Protocol v3 metrics (V3-038/V3-039) and any future protocol v4 metrics are NOT directly comparable without disclosing the input-boundary semantic change this task makes -- V3-039's Development Variant C false-confidence rate (6.48%, RESOLVER-V3-041 gate re-decision) was measured under the old, article/quantity-polluted boundary and must not be silently compared against a future protocol v4 run that uses the corrected boundary.

futureProtocolRequirement: RESOLVER-V3-048 (protocol v4 controlled live re-evidence) MUST use the corrected, production-faithful Variant A/C fast-path input boundary fixed by this task (ResolverV3VariantAAdapter.runVariantACase). This task supplies that binding input-boundary decision; it does not itself define the full protocol-v4 evidence contract, execution-tree hash, frozen plan, or budget authorization (RESOLVER-V3-048's own scope).
